name: Raw Cauliflower Florets (High Fermentation Bloat Warning)
whyItWorks: Dense cruciferous structure: Raw cauliflower florets are hard, abrasive to inflamed intestinal lining, and packed with complex oligosaccharides that humans cannot digest without severe bacterial gas production.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Avoid raw cauliflower crudité platters. If eating cauliflower, steam until completely mushy and puree into smooth cauliflower mash.
watchOuts: Severe gas and distension risk; avoid entirely during flares and active disease.
